remainingBoundaries: No universal optimum or never-retune guarantee: application cost, RAM/RSS, account mix and vendor/hardware changes can alter the best settings.
An unfunded concurrent peer may legitimately require a drained rebalance or warm-cache eviction; preserving every cache under memory pressure is not promised.
RSS is an admission estimate; kernel cgroup limits remain the enforced boundary.
Clean-OS fresh installation and unknown future vendor releases are not certified by these existing-host tests.
Shared Redis is intentionally shared. CSF, SSL and backup configuration are outside this task.
Website-specific CPU bottlenecks and currency/checkout behavior are deferred. USD default with geolocated BDT and no loading mask is recorded as intended behavior.

unitRegressions.environment: Linux root, disposable mocked fixtures; separate from live comparisons

decision.meaning: Keep the balanced measured defaults. Eight retains wait-heavy concurrency without assuming sixteen 120-MiB workers are safe. CPU-bound throughput plateaus near the existing quota; no universal optimum or fixed shopper count follows.
